title: Plotting Minute-Level Activity Data
text: Use acti_plot_time() inspect activity across entire recording. breaks argument accepts ordinary duration strings sets interval time-axis labels.  legible complete-recording axis, set x_axis = "12 hours". shows date 12-hour-clock labels midnight noon. Alternatively, x_axis = "midnight" prints just date midnight, without 00:00:00.
code: acti_plot_time(activity, counts, breaks = "4 hours") acti_plot_time(activity, counts, x_axis = "12 hours") acti_plot_time(activity, counts, x_axis = "midnight")

title: Plotting Minute-Level Activity Data
text: Use acti_plot_day() align day time--day axis. facet row one calendar date, makes day--day activity patterns easy compare.  Set facet = "month-day" remove year date strips, facet = "day" use baseline-relative day calculated actibase::acti_separate_times().
code: acti_plot_day(activity, counts, breaks = "4 hours") acti_plot_day(activity, counts, facet = "month-day") acti_plot_day(activity, counts, facet = "day")

title: Plot minute-level activity over time — acti_plot_time
text: data data frame containing timestamp activity measure. value activity-measure column, supplied unquoted string. example, steps "counts". time timestamp column, supplied unquoted string. time default. breaks single duration "1 hour", "4 hours", "15 mins". controls x-axis spacing. Use NULL ggplot2's default full-time plot specified breaks aligned plots. x_axis x-axis labelling scheme acti_plot_time(). Use "default" use breaks ggplot2's default; "12 hours" show date 12-hour clock label every 12 hours; "midnight" label date midnight. latter two options set breaks. ... Additional arguments passed primary geom. facet facet labels acti_plot_day(): "date" full date, "month-day" date without year, "day" days since first recording day (calculated actibase::acti_separate_times()).
